source_note: MIT OpenCourseWare 24.209 'Philosophy In Film and Other Media' (Spring 2004): Calendar page (session table, https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/24-209-philosophy-in-film-and-other-media-spring-2004/pages/calendar/), Syllabus page, and Video Lectures gallery (four sessions recorded for OCW, no per-session prose); fetched 2026-10-21.

lectures.title: Introduction
lectures.summary: Opening session of the course. The calendar pairs the introduction with a screening of Sturges's The Lady Eve.

lectures.title: Singer, Reality Transformed; The Lady Eve commentary
lectures.summary: The session is built around Irving Singer's book Reality Transformed together with his commentary on The Lady Eve, the film screened in the opening session.

lectures.title: Singer, 'Imagination' and 'Idealization'; Jeunet, Amélie
lectures.summary: Two of Singer's essays, 'Imagination' and 'Idealization,' are read in connection with a screening of Jeunet's Amélie.

lectures.title: James, Washington Square; Holland, Washington Square
lectures.summary: James's Washington Square is read alongside Holland's film of the same title, continuing the course's pairing of literature with cinema.

lectures.title: Singer, 'Consummation'; Wyler, The Heiress
lectures.summary: Singer's essay 'Consummation' is paired with a screening of Wyler's The Heiress.

lectures.title: Shaw, Pygmalion (including the prose Epilogue); Asquith, Pygmalion
lectures.summary: Shaw's Pygmalion, including its prose Epilogue, is read together with Asquith's film version of Pygmalion.

lectures.title: Bédier, The Romance of Tristan and Iseult; Delannoy, The Eternal Return
lectures.summary: Bédier's The Romance of Tristan and Iseult is read in connection with Delannoy's film The Eternal Return.

lectures.title: James, The Turn of the Screw; Weigl, The Turn of the Screw
lectures.summary: James's The Turn of the Screw is read alongside Weigl's film adaptation of the same title.

lectures.title: Singer, 'Alfred Hitchcock'; Hitchcock, Vertigo
lectures.summary: Singer's essay on Alfred Hitchcock accompanies a screening of Vertigo. The first paper is due at this session.

lectures.title: Joyce, 'The Dead'; Huston, The Dead
lectures.summary: Joyce's 'The Dead' is read together with Huston's film adaptation of the same title.

lectures.title: Singer, 'The Meaning of Death' and 'The Love of Life'; Bergman, The Seventh Seal
lectures.summary: Two Singer essays, 'The Meaning of Death' and 'The Love of Life,' are paired with a screening of Bergman's The Seventh Seal.

lectures.title: Discussion of Previous Readings and Screenings
lectures.summary: Concluding discussion session reviewing the course's previous readings and screenings. The second paper is due at this session.
